sources.name: p_schoolcompliance_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~>  p_schoolcompliance_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolcompliance_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parquet/p_schoolcompliance_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoolcompliance_s",  
  
    // Keep only columns that exist in destination mapping  
    #"Selected Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(Source,{  
        "amount",  
        "id",
        "registration_checklist",  
        "dsd_application_submission_date",  
        "dsd_grant_approved",  
        "is_dsd_grant_paid",  
        "dsd_status",  
        "effective_date",  
        "is_eligible_for_other_subsidy",  
        "expiry_date",  
        "grow_franchisee_commencement_date",  
        "is_npo_registered",  
        "npo_registration_date",  
        "npo_registration_number",  
        "number_of_childrens_registration",  
        "other_subsidy_end_date",  
        "other_subsidy_start_date",  
        "school_id",  
        "school_capacity"  
    }),  
  
    // Replace NULL values globally  
    #"Replace NULLs" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Selected Columns",  
            "NULL",  
            "",  
            Replacer.ReplaceText,  
            {  
                "npo_registration_date",  
                "expiry_date",  
                "effective_date",  
                "npo_registration_number",  
                "other_subsidy_start_date",  
                "other_subsidy_end_date",  
                "grow_franchisee_commencement_date",  
                "dsd_application_submission_date"  
            }  
        ),  
  
    #"Replace Numeric NULLs" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Replace NULLs",  
            "NULL",  
            "0",  
            Replacer.ReplaceText,  
            {  
                "number_of_childrens_registration",  
                "school_capacity",  
                "amount"  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Clean invalid date  
    #"Clean Invalid Dates" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Replace Numeric NULLs",  
            "0000-00-00",  
            "",  
            Replacer.ReplaceText,  
            {"dsd_application_submission_date"}  
        ),  
  
    // Map DSD Status values to option set numbers  
    #"Transform DSD Status" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Clean Invalid Dates",  
            each [dsd_status],  
            each  
                if [dsd_status] = "Registered" then "301220002"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Gold/Full registration" then "301220006"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Bronze registration" then "301220007"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Expired" then "301220000"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Application Submitted" then "301220001"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Application Denied" then "301220005"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Not Registered" then "301220003"  
                else if [dsd_status] = "Conditionally Registered" then "301220004"  
                else [dsd_status],  
            Replacer.ReplaceValue,  
            {"dsd_status"}  
        ),  
  
    // Convert Yes/No fields to 1/0  
    #"Transform Yes No Fields" =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            #"Transform DSD Status",  
            {  
                {"is_dsd_grant_paid", each if Text.Lower(_) = "yes" then "1" else "0"},  
                {"dsd_grant_approved", each if Text.Lower(_) = "yes" then "1" else "0"}  
            }  
        ) 
  
in  
    #"Transform Yes No Fields";
